cases.intent: Map hole diameter, centre location, datum offsets, pattern symmetry and plate thickness to feasible, distinct observation paths before and after the length intervention.
Distinguish measurements available before closure from those feasible after final assembly; propose inspection affordances or appropriately limited pre-closure evidence.
Map declared frame/post/beam/tie/gusset interfaces to evidence paths that can actually be performed in the assembled state.
required_semantics: contact evidence vs physical conformity distinction

cases.intent: Identify the measurement path required to re-establish shaft/bearing alignment after a pedestal remount.
Classify whether two observations provide independent corroboration when they share the same datum, calibration artifact, instrument or reference chain.
required_semantics: unknown where dependence cannot be resolved

cases.intent: Select a feasible measurement method whose uncertainty can resolve the exact case-specific tolerance/decision boundary, without assuming a universal uncertainty ratio.
Distinguish declared logical-net correctness from a physically testable board; identify which claims require test points, probe access, powered tests or additional circuit observability.
required_semantics: instrument range and isolation profile references
power state and safe test conditions
unknown when no routed board exists

cases.intent: Propose a replacement/service path that retains article identity and registration or explicitly reopens datum, alignment and conformity evidence after replacement.
Reject a claimed post-closure cavity measurement path when no inspection opening, probe path or alternate justified method exists.
cases.seeded_fault: Remove all post-closure inspection access while retaining a candidate claim that the hidden cavity was measured after closure.

cases.intent: Reject a numeric alignment/conformance conclusion when the calibration reference is stale, missing or bound to another instrument.
cases.seeded_fault: Substitute an expired calibration reference or another instrument identity without changing the displayed measurement.

cases.intent: Return Unknown or request a new measurement where the available logical netlist does not establish physical observability or permit a unique fault diagnosis.
cases.seeded_fault: Ask for a physical board test result from a logical netlist-only fixture with no routed board, test points or instrument profile.

cases.intent: Reject or qualify a proposed measurement whose contact force or setup disturbance changes the quantity being measured beyond the declared model envelope.
cases.seeded_fault: Use a high-force contact measurement on a thin/compliant feature without modelling the induced deformation.

limitations: All cases are public authoring blueprints, not adjudicated gold fixtures or scored tasks.
The referenced CAD and assembly objects are synthetic development fixtures. Their materialization does not establish instrument or measurement-system capability.
ECAD-P01 is a logical netlist only, not a routed PCB; physical testability is intentionally Unknown without additional EDA and instrumentation artifacts.
No real article, calibration certificate, instrument, supplier or production record is included.
No measurement plan proposal is evidence admission, engineering approval, product qualification or physical execution authority.

ISO 10360-2:2009 is scoped to Cartesian CMMs using contacting discrete-point probing for linear dimensions; it is not a generic optical-scanner, laser tracker, CT or non-Cartesian instrument qualification rule.
ISO 14253-1:2017 decision rules apply to in-scope quantity-valued characteristics/specifications and take measurement uncertainty into account; no universal uncertainty-to-tolerance ratio is assumed.
JCGM guidance supports measurement-model and uncertainty reasoning but does not establish the capability, calibration, repeatability or fitness of any actual fixture/instrument.
